mapper.select: select * from integration_schema.job_run where run_id=#{runId} for update
select * from integration_schema.job_run where job_code=#{jobCode} and xxl_job_id=#{jobId} and xxl_log_key=#{logKey} and xxl_shard_index=#{shardIndex} for update

select r.* from integration_schema.job_run r join integration_schema.job_definition d using(job_code) where d.resource_key=#{resourceKey} and r.status in ('PENDING','RUNNING','RETRY_WAIT','CANCEL_REQUESTED') and r.run_id != #{excludedRun} order by r.created_at limit 1

select r.*,d.resource_key from integration_schema.job_run r join integration_schema.job_definition d using(job_code) where d.enabled=true and r.trigger_type<>'XXL' and (r.status='PENDING' or (r.status='RETRY_WAIT' and r.next_retry_at<=clock_timestamp())) order by r.created_at limit 20 for update of r skip locked
select r.*,d.resource_key,d.enabled from integration_schema.job_run r join integration_schema.job_definition d using(job_code) where r.run_id=#{runId} for update of r,d

select r.*,d.resource_key from integration_schema.job_run r join integration_schema.job_definition d using(job_code) join integration_schema.job_lease l on l.resource_key=d.resource_key where r.status in ('RUNNING','CANCEL_REQUESTED') and (l.lease_until<clock_timestamp() or r.owner_id is distinct from l.owner_id or r.fence_token is distinct from l.fence_token) for update of r skip locked
mapper.update: update integration_schema.job_run set status='FAILED',error_code=#{code},error_summary=#{summary}, finished_at=clock_timestamp(),next_retry_at=null where run_id=#{runId} and status='PENDING'
update integration_schema.job_run set status='SUCCEEDED',phase='COMPLETED', finished_at=clock_timestamp(),next_retry_at=null where run_id=#{runId}

update integration_schema.job_run set status=case when status='RUNNING' then 'CANCEL_REQUESTED' else 'CANCELLED' end, finished_at=case when status='RUNNING' then null else clock_timestamp() end where run_id=#{runId} and status in ('PENDING','RUNNING','RETRY_WAIT')
update integration_schema.job_run set status='CANCELLED',finished_at=clock_timestamp() where run_id=#{runId} and owner_id=#{owner} and fence_token=#{token} and status='CANCEL_REQUESTED'

update integration_schema.job_run set status=#{status}, next_retry_at=case when #{status}='RETRY_WAIT' then clock_timestamp() else null end, finished_at=case when #{status} in ('FAILED','CANCELLED') then clock_timestamp() else null end, error_code='LEASE_EXPIRED',error_summary='执行实例失联，已从最后成功页恢复' where run_id=#{runId}
